KilimMotifs.constructor(address,address,uint256,address[],bytes32,address,bytes32,string,string).namesChunk_ (src/KilimMotifs.sol#62) lacks a zero-check on :
		- namesChunk = namesChunk_ (src/KilimMotifs.sol#92)

KilimAuction._claim(uint256,address) (src/KilimAuction.sol#166-193) has external calls inside a loop: motifs.mintMotifs(to,bidder,firstIds[i],counts[i]) (src/KilimAuction.sol#190)
	Calls stack containing the loop:
		KilimAuction.claimMotifs(uint256,address)

Reentrancy in EnglishAuction._refundOutbid(address,uint256) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#238-251):
	External calls:
	- this.payOutbidRefund{gas: REFUND_GAS}(bidder,amount) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#244-250)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- refundLiability += amount (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#248)
	- refunds[bidder] += amount (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#247)

Reentrancy in KilimAuction.deliverPrize() (src/KilimAuction.sol#218-224):
	External calls:
	- oneOfOne.mint(winner) (src/KilimAuction.sol#222)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- PrizeClaimed(winner,winner) (src/KilimAuction.sol#223)

Reentrancy in EnglishAuction._refundOutbid(address,uint256) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#238-251):
	External calls:
	- this.payOutbidRefund{gas: REFUND_GAS}(bidder,amount) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#244-250)

	- RefundDeferred(bidder,amount) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#249)
	- RefundPaid(bidder,amount) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#245)

EnglishAuction.registerFor(address,uint256,bytes) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#121-130) uses timestamp for comparisons

	- block.timestamp > deadline (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#122)

EnglishAuction._handleBid(uint256) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#202-229) uses timestamp for comparisons

	- extended > endsAt (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#227)

EnglishAuction.settle() (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#167-175) uses timestamp for comparisons

	- block.timestamp < endsAt (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#170)

EnglishAuction.constructor(EnglishAuction.AuctionConfig) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#93-110) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- config.treasury == address(0) || config.treasury == address(this) || config.startsAt <= block.timestamp || config.duration > 2592000 || config.extensionWindow == 0 || config.extensionWindow > config.duration || config.incrementBps == 0 || config.incrementBps > MAX_BPS || config.reservePrice != REGISTRATION_BALANCE (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#98-102)

EnglishAuction._register(address) (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#136-145) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < startsAt || registrationCount >= REGISTRATION_TARGET (src/auction/EnglishAuction.sol#137)
